records.title: MoEMeta: Mixture-of-Experts Meta Learning for Few-Shot Relational Learning
records.reason: MoEMeta uses mixture-of-experts meta-learning for few-shot relational learning, not large language model inference or MoE serving efficiency.

records.title: Mitigating Coordinate Prediction Bias from Positional Encoding Failures
records.reason: This paper mitigates positional-encoding coordinate prediction bias in spatial prediction, not LLM inference resources or serving.

records.title: LayerNorm Induces Recency Bias in Transformer Decoders
records.reason: The paper attributes decoder recency bias to LayerNorm/causal attention and states that overall model performance is not evaluated. It offers positional insight but no KV-cache or inference-cost optimization.

records.title: Arg-LLaDA: Argument Summarization via Large Language Diffusion Models and Sufficiency-Aware Refinement
records.reason: Arg-LLaDA applies diffusion generation and sufficiency-aware refinement to argument summarization. Full text evaluates summarization quality, not inference FLOPs, latency, memory or serving cost; only a weak generation-family connection remains.

records.title: Controlling What You Share: Assessing Language Model Adherence to Privacy Preferences
records.reason: The full text studies adherence to privacy-sharing preferences using profiles, verification/paraphrasing and local-model fallback. Its objective is privacy behavior, not model routing or inference efficiency.
